name: Conchiglie Buttered Lobster Pasta
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
whyItWorks: Soft white semolina shell pasta and tender buttered lobster meat provide a low-fiber, high-protein comfort dish.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If you follow a strict citrus guardrail or are avoiding tomato acidity, ask for the lobster pasta tossed in plain garlic butter and parmesan instead of the tomato-tarragon-lemon brandy sauce.
